title: Vitamin D Increases Serum Levels of the Soluble Receptor for Advanced Glycation End Products in Women With PCOS
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the mechanism that explain the beneficial clinical effect of vitamin D treatment in women with PCOS.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Vitamin D deficient premenopausal women

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
* Women during their postpartum period
* Breastfeeding women
* Women taking any kind of exogenous hormones
* Women receiving any form of oral vitamin D replacement
